title: Exposure triangle
summary: Aperture, shutter and ISO trade off against each other.

blocks.text: Three settings decide how bright a photo is. Move one by a stop and you must move another a stop the **opposite** way to keep the same brightness.

blocks.alt: Shutter, aperture and ISO stop scales lined up, brighter to the left, darker to the right
Triangle with aperture at the top, shutter bottom left and ISO bottom right, each with its side effect and range
blocks.caption: Each corner sets brightness and has a side effect: depth of field, motion blur or noise.

head: Setting
More light
Less light
Side effect
rows: Wide = blurred background. Narrow = more in focus.
Slow = motion blur. Fast = frozen action.

items: The subject blurs, so speed up the shutter 2 stops: **1/500 s**
Win the light back by opening 2 stops: **f/8**. ISO stays at 100.
